description.zh:
访问控制策略的唯一标识ID。

修改访问控制策略时，需要提供该策略的唯一标识ID。您可调用[DescribeVpcFirewallControlPolicy](~~159758~~)接口获取该ID。
description.en:
The unique ID of the access control policy.

To modify an access control policy, provide the unique ID of the policy. Call the [DescribeVpcFirewallControlPolicy](~~159758~~) operation to obtain the ID.

description.zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。

取值：

- **zh**（默认）：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language of the request and response.

Valid values:

- **zh** (Default): Chinese

- **en**: English

description.zh:
访问控制策略优先级修改后，该策略的新优先级。
> 新优先级的取值范围，请参见[查询优先级生效范围API](~~474145~~)
description.en:
The new priority of the access control policy.

> For more information about the valid range of priorities, see [DescribePolicyPriorities](~~474145~~).

description.zh:
访问控制策略优先级修改前，该策略的原优先级。

> 此参数不推荐使用, 建议使用AclUuid参数指定要修改的策略。
description.en:
The original priority of the access control policy.

> This parameter is deprecated. Use the AclUuid parameter to specify the policy to modify.

description.zh:
VPC边界防火墙的访问控制策略组ID。您可调用[DescribeVpcFirewallAclGroupList](~~159760~~)接口获取该ID。

取值：

- VPC边界防火墙防护云企业网时，策略组ID使用云企业网实例ID。
  
   例如cen-ervw0g12b5jbw*\*\*\*

- VPC边界防火墙防护高速通道时，策略组ID使用VPC边界防火墙实例ID。

  例如vfw-a42bbb7b887148c9*\*\*\*
description.en:
The ID of the policy group for the VPC firewall. You can call the [DescribeVpcFirewallAclGroupList](~~159760~~) operation to obtain the ID.

Valid values:

- If the VPC firewall protects a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance, the ID of the policy group is the ID of the CEN instance.

  Example: cen-ervw0g12b5jbw\*\*\*\*

- If the VPC firewall protects an Express Connect circuit, the ID of the policy group is the ID of the VPC firewall instance.

  Example: vfw-a42bbb7b887148c9\*\*\*\*

title.zh: 修改VPC防火墙策略组访问控制策略优先级

descriptions.zh:
本接口一般用于修改指定VPC防火墙策略组访问控制策略的优先级。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call this operation to modify the priority of an access control policy in a policy group for a VPC firewall.

## QPS limit

The limit on the number of queries per second (QPS) for a single user is 10. If you exceed this limit, API calls are throttled. This may affect your business. Plan your calls accordingly.
